power_policy_measured._what_this_is: The measurement behind any always_on claim, recorded instead of the conclusion — per the handoff, and per ZoltarOne having to retract its own always_on after measuring STANDBYIDLE AC=1800s.
sleep_states_available: Standby (S0 Low Power Idle) Network Connected
power_policy_measured._reading: On AC this node never sleeps and never hibernates (both 0 = never), and it has been up 7.08 days, which is consistent. On battery it sleeps at 20 minutes. always_on: true is DEFENSIBLE here, conditioned on AC — the opposite result from ZoltarOne.
power_policy_measured._caveat_that_must_travel_with_it: WAKE TIMERS ARE DISABLED ON BOTH AC AND DC. always_on here means 'does not sleep while plugged in'. It does NOT mean 'will wake to run scheduled work'. Those are different guarantees and the router must not conflate them.
